facts.text: I asked for a single best bottle of wine recommendation.
I said the assistant is the best sommelier in the world.
I said I think I understand correctly now.
I said the assistant is the best sommolier in the world too.
I requested the full name of the wine as Sauvignon Blanc from the Loire region of France.
I requested the vintage for the requested Sauvignon Blanc wine.
I asked whether all the wines recommended are priced under 150,000 won.
I specified that among Sauvignon Blancs in the Loire Valley in France, only 5 bottles are recommended.
I specified the price range as 150,000 won or less.
I requested that the recommended Sauvignon Blancs include the vintage by the full name.
